class.name: OcgGpXYZ
class.brief_description: This class describes a cartesian coordinate entity in 3D space {X,Y,Z}. This entity is used for algebraic calculation. This entity can be transformed with a "Trsf" or a "GTrsf" from package "gp". It is used in vectorial computations or for holding this type of information in data structures.
class.description: ! This class describes a cartesian coordinate entity in ! 3D space {X,Y,Z}. This entity is used for algebraic ! calculation. This entity can be transformed ! with a "Trsf" or a "GTrsf" from package "gp". ! It is used in vectorial computations or for holding this type ! of information in data structures.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an XYZ object with zero coordinates (0,0,0)

method.name: from_2
method.description: creates an XYZ with given coordinates

method.name: SetCoord_2
method.description: For this XYZ object, assigns the values theX, theY and theZ to its three coordinates

method.name: SetCoord_1
method.description: modifies the coordinate of range theIndex theIndex = 1 => X is modified theIndex = 2 => Y is modified theIndex = 3 => Z is modified Raises OutOfRange if theIndex != {1, 2, 3}.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate

method.name: SetY
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Y coordinate

method.name: SetZ
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Z coordinate

method.name: X
method.description: Returns the X coordinate

method.name: Y
method.description: Returns the Y coordinate

method.name: Z
method.description: Returns the Z coordinate

method.name: Modulus
method.description: computes Sqrt (X*X + Y*Y + Z*Z) where X, Y and Z are the three coordinates of this XYZ object.

method.name: SquareModulus
method.description: Computes X*X + Y*Y + Z*Z where X, Y and Z are the three coordinates of this XYZ object.

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns True if he coordinates of this XYZ object are equal to the respective coordinates Other, within the specified tolerance theTolerance. I.e.: abs(<me>.X() - theOther.X()) <= theTolerance and abs(<me>.Y() - theOther.Y()) <= theTolerance and abs(<me>.Z() - theOther.Z()) <= theTolerance.

method.name: Add
method.description: ! @code ! <me>.X() = <me>.X() + theOther.X() ! <me>.Y() = <me>.Y() + theOther.Y() ! <me>.Z() = <me>.Z() + theOther.Z() ! @endcode

method.name: Added
method.description: ! @code ! new.X() = <me>.X() + theOther.X() ! new.Y() = <me>.Y() + theOther.Y() ! new.Z() = <me>.Z() + theOther.Z() ! @endcode

method.name: Cross
method.description: ! @code ! <me>.X() = <me>.Y() * theOther.Z() - <me>.Z() * theOther.Y() ! <me>.Y() = <me>.Z() * theOther.X() - <me>.X() * theOther.Z() ! <me>.Z() = <me>.X() * theOther.Y() - <me>.Y() * theOther.X() ! @endcode

method.name: Crossed
method.description: ! @code ! new.X() = <me>.Y() * theOther.Z() - <me>.Z() * theOther.Y() ! new.Y() = <me>.Z() * theOther.X() - <me>.X() * theOther.Z() ! new.Z() = <me>.X() * theOther.Y() - <me>.Y() * theOther.X() ! @endcode

method.name: CrossMagnitude
method.description: Computes the magnitude of the cross product between <me> and theRight. Returns || <me> ^ theRight ||

method.name: CrossSquareMagnitude
method.description: Computes the square magnitude of the cross product between <me> and theRight. Returns || <me> ^ theRight ||**2

method.name: CrossCross
method.description: Triple vector product Computes <me> = <me>.Cross(theCoord1.Cross(theCoord2))

method.name: CrossCrossed
method.description: Triple vector product computes New = <me>.Cross(theCoord1.Cross(theCoord2))

method.name: Divide
method.description: divides <me> by a real.

method.name: Divided
method.description: divides <me> by a real.

method.name: Dot
method.description: computes the scalar product between <me> and theOther

method.name: DotCross
method.description: computes the triple scalar product

method.name: Multiply_1
Multiply_2
Multiply_3
method.description: <me> = theMatrix * <me>

method.name: Multiplied_1
Multiplied_2
Multiplied_3
method.description: New = theMatrix * <me>

method.name: Normalize
method.description: Raised if <me>.Modulus() <= Resolution from gp

method.name: Normalized
method.description: Raised if <me>.Modulus() <= Resolution from gp

method.name: Reverse
method.description: ! @code ! <me>.X() = -<me>.X() ! <me>.Y() = -<me>.Y() ! <me>.Z() = -<me>.Z() ! @endcode

method.name: Reversed
method.description: ! @code ! New.X() = -<me>.X() ! New.Y() = -<me>.Y() ! New.Z() = -<me>.Z() ! @endcode

method.name: Subtract
method.description: ! @code ! <me>.X() = <me>.X() - theOther.X() ! <me>.Y() = <me>.Y() - theOther.Y() ! <me>.Z() = <me>.Z() - theOther.Z() ! @endcode

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: ! @code ! new.X() = <me>.X() - theOther.X() ! new.Y() = <me>.Y() - theOther.Y() ! new.Z() = <me>.Z() - theOther.Z() ! @endcode
